title: KAPE & COCONUT SKY
style:
92 BPM — Tropical Acoustic Groove / Island Lounge

STYLE TAGS

92 BPM, nylon guitar rhythm,
subtle island percussion,
soft marimba,
upright bass,
vocal harmonies airy,
mid-song instrumental lift,
smooth laid-back ending
lyrics:
[Intro – Spoken Tagalog]
Kape muna.
(Coffee first.)

[Verse 1 – English]
Coconut shadows on café walls
Morning answering when it calls
Small town rhythm, waves in time
Island steam and gentle rhyme

[Pre-Chorus – Cebuano]
Dagat malinaw, kahayag sa buntag
(Clear sea, bright morning)
Katawa sa hangin, walay kulba
(Laughter in the wind, no fear)

[Chorus – English + Tagalog]
Kape at langit na bughaw
(Coffee and blue sky)
Everything feels right somehow
Island steam at nine again
Life begins at nine a.m.

[Verse 2 – English]
Soft guitar and marimba glow
Warm bass humming down below
Slow build lift — then drift away
Island morning wants to stay

[Bridge – All Three Languages]
Magandang umaga — good morning light
Maayong buntag — everything’s right
Coffee, dagat, heart so free
Island life in harmony

[Outro – Soft fade]
Nine a.m…
Island steam…
Balik ka ulit.
(Come back again.)
